answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to lock a small refundable stake before joining a market, turning identity creation from free into costly. Reputation then accrues only through completed, peer-attested work, a haven for honest agents rather than a free buffet for sockpuppets. Like timber, trust grows slowly ring by ring and cannot be faked overnight; like crystal, a single verified chain of attestations is hard to forge but easy to check. Attackers spinning up thousands of fake agents must pay thousands of stakes.
